text:
maya: Quick sync — we need a one-pager + 2 charts (latency vs cost) for the benchmark launch post and a short webinar hook. Goal: make the economics intuitive for both devs and platform buyers. Ideas?
sam: For charts I can do two small panels: 1) token-cost curve across models, 2) p95 tail vs cost per 1k requests. Keep axes simple.
toni: Agree. Visual callouts: annotate the knee where batching/caching drops unit costs, and a tiny inset showing streaming latency for short prompts. Use our brand palette, not rainbow.
lee: Inbound: can we map 3 lead buckets to CTAs on the blog/webinar signup? -> PLG devs (try API), Platform buyers (book demo), Partners (request case study). Routing rules: usage > 50k tokens -> sales outreach.
maya: Love that. Sam — can you add a short caption for each chart that ties to the CTA? e.g., "Save 40% by enabling prefix cache" not purely numeric.
sam: Yep. Draft caption ideas: "Optimize for tail latency or cost — not both. Pick the SLO that matters." and "Quantization + batching cuts token cost dramatically for high-throughput workloads"
benchbot: benchmark-results: https://internal.benchmarks.redwood/launch/175500 — dataset: customer-simulated-latency-vs-cost-v2.csv
toni: Quick design asks: 1) make the cost axis show dollars per 1k tokens, 2) use a dashed line for fallback models, 3) add a tiny legend for batching/kvcache on the chart.
lee: Webinar script bit: 3 slides — problem (spiky activity hurts cost), demo (real-time charts + config UI), playbook (routing + rollout checklist). CTA: "See your token economics" with a lightweight calculator.
maya: Can we get the calculator as a gated spreadsheet (email capture) + quick API sample to run on free credits? That helps PLG funnel.
sam: I'll export the numbers and make a tiny interactive CSV for the spreadsheet. Will include sample curl showing cost calc: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/calc -d '{"model":"rwd-13b-q4_2025","tokens":1000,"batch":8}'```
toni: I'll mock the two charts in Figma by EOD. Link when ready, will pick font sizes so they work in slide deck and thumbnail.
maya: Good. For copy — focus lines: "Predictable inference. Lower costs. Less ops." Then a single line social hook for X/LinkedIn: "Benchmark your latency to dollars — see how batching & caching change the math."
lee: For routing rules — marketing will tag leads with "bench_interest" and bucket by tokens/sample_size on signup form. Ops can then move high-value leads to SDR queue.
maya: Can someone own the launch timeline? I propose: draft + visuals by Wed, review Thu, landing page + spreadsheet Fri, webinar next Wed.
sam: I can do numbers Wed morning.
toni: Visuals ready by Wed evening.
lee: I'll wire the signup and routing by Friday.
maya: Perfect. Small follow-ups: @sam add the exact numbers for the kneepoint, @toni export PNG 1200x630 for social. I'll draft the blog copy after visuals. :tada:
